stories.name: Production Infrastructure on Terraform (IaC Migration)
stories.rationale: Migrated production and staging environments fully onto Terraform-managed infrastructure, including the staging module tree, post-cutover cleanup, and convergence of both environments.

stories.name: Database Security Hardening (Remove Public IP Access)
stories.rationale: Removed public IP access from both staging and production databases, routing all admin access through the VPN for improved security posture.

stories.name: Client VPN Enablement for Production
stories.rationale: Enabled the production Client VPN and converged staging to match, establishing VPN as the secure admin access path.

stories.name: Production Email Authentication & DNS Configuration
stories.rationale: Configured AMVU and SPF DNS records for skematic.ai in both production and staging to ensure proper email authentication and deliverability.

stories.name: DevOps: Secrets Management Docs & CI Optimization
stories.rationale: Documented the per-key secrets management approach and optimized CI pipelines to skip Terraform plan runs on documentation-only changes.

stories.name: AWS Marketplace ACE Integration Fixes
stories.rationale: Resolved multiple ACE integration issues including rejection of invalid Discovery UUID Marketplace product ARNs, re-resolution of malformed ARNs, and omission of redundant fields when a solution is already associated.

stories.name: AWS Product Selector UI
stories.rationale: Built the AWS product selector UI component to support users in selecting AWS products within the platform workflow.

stories.name: AWS Partner Central MCP Integration
stories.rationale: Implemented the MCP and Partner Central integration to enable deeper AWS partner ecosystem connectivity within Skematic.

stories.name: ACE Data Quality: Default Currency & Schema Sync
stories.rationale: Improved ACE data quality by defaulting missing monetary currency values to USD and syncing main branch schema changes into staging.
